aboutus.title: About us
aboutus.text-1: We are a construction company with more than 15 years of experience, taking our clients by the hand throughout the whole process, from the design, obtaining all the legal permits and then carrying out the construction of the house of their dreams.
aboutus.text-2: We know that owning a property in Puerto Peñasco is the dream of many of us who are looking for sun, beach and a little piece of blue.
aboutus.text-3: We are committed to deliver quality work, to make your experience a pleasant one, remember our motto “First class or no class”.
aboutus.info-1: We have a team of architects to make any type of design.
aboutus.info-2: We have a team of qualified engineers to carry out the execution of the work.
aboutus.info-3: We have a team of qualified personnel to carry out any type of remodeling.
